  Scenario: AC8 The retention class, the write-once flag and the field list come from the type in force, and rwb-document writes only its own tables (new, D-RCV-60; BR8, BR9, BR11, BR12, BR13)
    Given type "DEMAND_LETTER" has write_once true and retention class "LEGAL10Y" in version "DOCTYPE-2026.11"
    When a store request for type "DEMAND_LETTER" on case "RC-2026-000123" carries write_once false and retention class "GENERAL05Y" from the caller
    Then the document row carries write_once true and retention class "LEGAL10Y" from the version in force, and the caller's values are not written
    And a document_field fact outside the field list of type "DEMAND_LETTER" is refused and no document_field row is written for it
    And the store writes no retention action, no expiry and no disposal, these being held by RWB-P5-E1052-APP
    And the store reads no v_ace_* view, no public table and no other service's table, writes no interaction-ledger entry and starts no timer

  Scenario: AC9 A request without a valid login, without a Documents right or for an unknown document is answered 401, 403 or 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the provided operations of rwb-document are called through the gateway-bff route
    When a request without a valid login, a request from a role that holds no Documents right, and a request for a documentId that does not exist are sent to GET /api/recovery/document/v1/documents/{documentId}
    Then the request without a valid login is answered 401, the request from a role that holds no Documents right is answered 403 with MSG-P4-002 as in AC4, and the unknown documentId is answered 404
    And no answer carries document metadata, a field value or file content

  Scenario: AC10 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stores no partial document (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-comms contract mock does not answer the PDF request of notice "N-0001"
    When rwb-document stores the notice PDF on case "RC-2026-000123" through POST /api/recovery/document/v1/cases/{caseId}/documents with source "GENERATED"
    Then the store is answered as a failure with the answer code Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P5-E1055-APP-AC14)
    And no document row, no document_field row and no outbox row is written
